title: Persistent disk-backed caches
body:
- Question plans are now read individually from persistent SQLite storage instead of preloading and retaining a second application-memory cache.
- Flagdle now keeps downloaded flag SVGs on the persistent data volume and reuses them after backend restarts.
- Flag cache reads and downloads run off the request event loop; temporary upstream placeholders are not saved to disk.
- The admin Cache page now shows durable stored-plan counts and SQLite storage rather than RAM capacity.

Existing cached plans, saved player progress, game rules, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
